prompt_fragment: This asset is a top-down hex tile. Compose it for clear map readability, with the terrain filling the frame evenly and no horizon line.
raw_description:
Orthographic top-down view of an empty bone-grey snow waste — faint wind
scour patterns, a few dark protruding pebbles, pale cracked surface.
Muted, almost abstract.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink and watercolor hex tile, orthographic top-down view of a bone-grey snow waste on aged vellum parchment, faint wind-scour ridges and cracked pale surface punctuated by slate ink pebbles and warm vellum cream snow-crust.

subjects.description: pale fractured crust with hairline cracks radiating across the tile, wind-scour grooves in shallow parallel arcs, filling the frame evenly
three or four small angular stones half-buried in snow, casting faint ink shadow, distributed asymmetrically across the field
